verdict.rationale: SES offers a sandbox described as 'an area where new users can test the capabilities of Amazon SES,' in which all features are usable (including event publishing to SNS/EventBridge/CloudWatch). However, sandbox sends still go out as real email, just restricted to verified identities, so it is an onboarding restriction rather than a no-delivery test mode. missing for 10: a documented no-delivery test mode or simulator, test API keys or a sandbox domain that accept messages without delivering them, evidence that test sends fire events, CI/agent-safety guidance, independent corroboration.
